description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of mentions across different news sources as reported by the Drudge Report. The chart contains 15 slices, each representing a different news outlet. The slices are labeled as follows: Breitbart (blue, 14%), Other (grey, 13%), The Huffington Post (red, 8%), NPR (purple, 7%), Vox (orange, 6%), The Guardian (light purple, 6%), BBC (dark blue, 5%), RT (teal, 4%), Daily Kos (yellow, 3%), National Review (pink, 3%), Daily Mail (brown, 3%), CNN (green, 3%), Fox News (red, 3%), Shareblue (light grey, 3%), and PoliticusUSA (dark grey, 3%). Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice. The slices appear to be arranged in a clockwise order, generally descending by proportion, with the largest slices appearing first. A legend is not present, but the labels are directly on the chart. No slices are visually emphasized through techniques like exploding or bolding.
